title: Fee Strategies, Holiday Decorator and Partial Payments
instructions: In `parking/fees.py` implement `started_hours`, `WeekdayFee`, `WeekendSlabFee`, `FeeStrategyFactory` and the `HolidayFee` decorator (the `VehicleType`, `Slab` and `FeeStrategy` declarations are given). In `parking/billing.py` implement the `Bill` properties `total_paid` (successful payments only) and `is_paid`, and `PaymentService.make_payment`: reject an overpayment before calling the gateway, record every attempt including failures, and free the spot only when the bill becomes paid.

evidence.label: Weekday pricing is 10 per started hour for every vehicle type, with started_hours rounding up to a one hour minimum
Weekend car slabs give 20, 70, 140 and 230 for 1, 3, 5 and 7 hours
Slab boundaries are marginal and unsorted slabs still work
Saturday and Sunday exits use the weekend tariff, other days the weekday one
HolidayFee multiplies the inner fee only when the exit date is a holiday
HolidayFee is itself a FeeStrategy and wraps any tariff, including another decorator
total_paid counts only SUCCESS payments and is_paid needs total_paid >= amount
A failed payment adds nothing, every attempt is recorded and a retry settles the bill, freeing the spot
An amount above the outstanding balance raises OverpaymentError without calling the gateway
Paying exactly the outstanding balance is allowed and frees the spot
